text: Five rows to remember. Grammar: the signal is an S, T, P, A, W error; apply the standard rule. Dangling modifier: an opening ing or ed phrase, with the wrong subject after the comma; add the right subject, or rewrite as a clause. Parallelism: a list, or a paired conjunction, with mixed forms; make all items the same form. Word choice: a confusable pair, or a broken idiom; use the correct word, or the fixed form. Redundancy: two words with the same meaning; remove one.
